title: Synthetic Trial of Asthma Controller Therapy
eligibility_criteria: Inclusion: adults with persistent asthma and documented wheezing. Exclusion: current tobacco use or recent respiratory infection.

title: Synthetic Diabetes Lifestyle Study
eligibility_criteria: Inclusion: adults with type 2 diabetes and elevated HbA1c. Exclusion: pregnancy or insulin pump use.

title: Synthetic Migraine Prevention Trial
eligibility_criteria: Inclusion: adults with recurrent migraine. Exclusion: uncontrolled hypertension or recent investigational drug use.
